project.name: OpenDating
project.description: A dating app built around coarse location and end-to-end encrypted direct messages. Your exact location never leaves your phone.
project.audience: people who want genuine dating without surveillance capitalism
differentiators: Cryptographic identity with a legacy recovery-key flow
Coarse location only — your exact GPS never reaches the server
Private likes — one-way likes are never public
Private blocks and reports — enforced server-side, never notified
No ads, no data harvesting, no surveillance business model
Open protocol with cross-provider portability planned after GA

android._comment: local:false builds in the cloud, so android-submit resolves the artifact with --latest instead of a path. The Android SDK on this machine lives on an exFAT volume whose AppleDouble sidecars break CMake globs, which is a second reason to prefer cloud.

blog._comment: mode 'expo-public' renders static HTML into public/blog/, which GitHub Pages serves verbatim.
